entries.title: Counterfactual Generative Networks
entries.evidence: Structured generator separates shape, texture and background mechanisms, using labels and inductive biases. Recombining mechanisms trains classifiers invariant to selected factors. This does not identify every natural image's causal structure.

entries.title: Representation Learning via Invariant Causal Mechanisms
entries.evidence: Assumes content and style are independent and only content determines downstream targets. Content-preserving augmentations simulate style interventions; proxy-prediction invariance is regularized. Predictive invariance cannot validate those assumptions.

entries.title: Noise or Signal: The Role of Image Backgrounds in Object Recognition
entries.coverage: method, BG-GAP and appendix artifact controls read
entries.evidence: ImageNet-9 foreground/background recombinations assess background dependence. Mixed-Same controls processing artifacts when compared with Mixed-Rand. The paper explicitly notes boundary artifacts and remaining background traces.

entries.title: Diversify Your Vision Datasets with Automatic Diffusion-Based Augmentation
entries.status: v2 author metadata and abstract read; full method pending
entries.evidence: ALIA uses language-guided image editing and a classifier trained on original data to filter minimal edits and class-information corruption. v2 metadata says Planes was replaced with Waterbirds and results updated after a bug fix.

entries.title: DDB: Diffusion Driven Balancing to Address Spurious Correlations
entries.authors: Aryan Yazdan Parast; Basim Azam; Naveed Akhtar
entries.status: arXiv v2 metadata read; venue unverified
entries.coverage: metadata and abstract; full method pending
entries.evidence: Uses textual inversion, language segmentation and diffusion to combine object components with other-class context; prunes generated samples using ERM probabilities and attribution before retraining.

entries.title: Breaking Spurious Correlations via Generative Randomization and Cross-Variant Self-Supervised Learning
entries.authors: Suraj Yadav; Anjaneya Sharma; Siddharth Yadav
entries.status: arXiv 2026-07-07; abstract page reports CVPR Workshop 2026 GCV acceptance, not main-track verification
entries.coverage: abstract, method outline and section index read; details pending
entries.evidence: Segments foregrounds, generates new contexts with structure-preserving diffusion, forms same-object positives across backgrounds, then ERM warmup plus GroupDRO. This directly precedes a generic background-generation-plus-consistency idea.

entries.title: SAGE: Subpopulation-Aware Generative Enhancement for Mitigating Spurious Correlations
entries.authors: Yiming Luo; Rongqiang Zhao; Jie Liu
entries.coverage: abstract, method index and appendix index read; details pending
entries.evidence: Uses cluster-derived sub-labels and labels to fine-tune a conditional generator, fill minority subpopulations and synthesize balanced validation data for last-layer reweighting. Includes synthetic-validation ablation.

not_done: No claim of complete novelty coverage
